mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies invest in productivity-enhancing technologies.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < -1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy coupled with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > +200k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < -1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals accommodative monetary policy with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.
